title: Token Issuance Instruments Register
description: Extension schema for the vwp-accounting-token-issuance extension: the register at facts/issuance-instruments.json. One entry per instrument through which the reporting entity issued, sold, promised or allocated its own token (SAFT, presale, public sale, airdrop, treasury allocation, service token), with the consideration received, the obligations the instrument carries, the balance-sheet classification concluded and the judgment that concluded it. The validators check that every instrument links a resolvable classification judgment, that no instrument with proceeds is left unclassified, and that the proceeds allocation ties to this register and to the proceeds facts it cites.

currency.description: Currency the proceeds are stated in.

counterparty.description: Generic label for the holder or class of holders (never a real name in registry content).

issuanceDate.description: Date consideration was received or the instrument was issued; the executable entry is dated here.

proceeds.description: Consideration received in the register currency (0 for airdrops and treasury allocations).

proceedsFact.description: Fact id whose numeric value equals proceeds. Required by the validators when proceeds > 0.

deliveryObligation.description: Whether the entity still owes token delivery under the instrument.

settlementInEntityTokens.description: Whether the obligation is settled only by delivering the entity's own token (relevant to ASC 480 and ASC 815).

serviceObligation.description: Whether the token conveys goods or services the entity must still provide (ASC 606).

classification.description: none is only valid for instruments with no proceeds (airdrops, treasury allocations).

termsEvidence.description: Evidence ids for the instrument's terms.
